## Detailed Findings

```
**Finding:** Missing document title element
**WCAG:** 2.4.2 Page Titled
**Perspective:** Screen Reader Semantic
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: Content Author)
**Evidence:** Component lacks `<title>` element in document head
**Fix:** Add `<title>Widget Pro | Acme Corp</title>` to document head

**Finding:** Missing `lang` attribute on `<html>` element
**WCAG:** 3.1.1 Language of Page
**Perspective:** Screen Reader Semantic
**Severity:** MAJOR
**Route to:** Front-End Dev (secondary: Content Author)
**Evidence:** `<html>` element lacks `lang` attribute
**Fix:** Add `lang="en"` to `<html>` tag
```

---

## Passed Items

- Landmark regions present and correctly used (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<aside>`, `<footer>`, multiple `<nav>` with `aria-label`)
- Logical heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 with `aria-labelledby`)
- All links have descriptive text (no "click here")
- Focus-visible outlines on all interactive elements
- Proper use of `aria-current="page"` on breadcrumb
- Responsive layout with accessible source order
- All links have underlined visual indicator (WCAG 1.4.1)

---

## Recommendations

1. Add `<title>` element to document head for page identification
2. Add `lang="en"` to `<html>` tag to declare document language
3. Consider adding `aria-label` to skip link for better screen reader context
4. Verify landmark usage with multiple `<nav>` elements in complex layouts

**Component Status:** Requires revision to address MAJOR accessibility issues affecting screen reader users' ability to identify the page and understand its language.
